discovery_notes: Cell B014 (Disney Store UK/EU + US/shopDisney, 2018). 30 standard searches, snippets only. Disney Park Pack 3.0 (shopDisney subscription, 3 LE 500 pins/month) recorded under dsus; DPB 'variant x of 3' suggests each design had 3 colour variants - not split. UP New Year 2018 pin released 2017-12-19 but keyed 2018 by its name. Mary Poppins Returns and Incredibles 2 EU listings undated. Skipped as duplicates: DLP pin advent calendar at shopDisney UK (in 206 as 2019; a DPB snippet suggested Oct 2018 - possible date conflict), Silly Symphony 90th (in 206). Out of scope/unverified leads: Disney Holiday Nutcrackers mystery collection (parks + shopDisney OE, 8 pins, Oct 2018), Disney Handbag Collectible Pin Pack (25 Feb 2018, 16 pins, retailer unclear), JCPenney Mickey 90 sets (licensed), Peter Pan 65th PTN (parks), DPB archive mention of Lion King/small world anniversary DS pins (dates implausible). Resellers (yourwdwstore, collectrandom etc.) not used.
